logline: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.

moments.description: The heavy cathedral doors swing open to reveal Juliana marched in chains like a criminal.
Aristocratic guests mock and sneer at Juliana's humiliating public disgrace.
moments.key_dialogue: Not as a bride this time.

moments.description: Despite being chained and bruised, Juliana stares down Catherine with fierce defiance.
moments.key_dialogue: You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?

moments.description: Catherine and Rupert clasp hands at the altar, celebrating their ruthless takeover of the Ashburgh title.
moments.key_dialogue: Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title.

moments.description: A deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, blowing the massive doors into splintered shrapnel.
As armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble, Juliana's face shifts into awe and sudden hope.
